meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把音频、字幕和画面素材合成视频,预览、批量出片并发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把素材批量做成带字幕和配音的成片。
copy.tagline_en: Render audio, captions, and visuals into previewable video, in batches, then publish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you assemble raw assets into finished videos with captions and voiceover.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 用 HyperFrames CLI 帮你做视频:初始化项目、搜索并安装动画组件、写合成、开浏览器预览、按质量档渲染并校验产物,构建或渲染报错时也用它排查。
howto.when: 当你要求做视频、动画或动态图形,要处理某个素材、声音、配音,或需要排查构建、渲染失败时,它会接管。

say.text: 用 catalog --query 搜一下「逐行显现标题」的现成动画组件
say.note: 搜索全在本地,查询不外发

say.text: 先跑 check,再开 preview --background 给我看时间线
按 delivery 质量档渲染成 out.mp4

howto.what_en: Claude uses the HyperFrames CLI to build videos: scaffold a project, search and install motion components, author compositions, open a browser preview, render at a quality tier, verify the output, and diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for a video, animation, or motion graphics, when a request names an asset, sound, or voice, or when build or render failures need diagnosing.

say_en.text: Search catalog --query for a ready-made headline-reveal component
say_en.note: Search runs locally; queries are not sent

say_en.text: Run check first, then open preview --background for the timeline
say_en.note: check runs lint before the browser

say_en.text: Render to out.mp4 at the delivery quality tier
